entries.q.tobacco.current: Do you currently use any tobacco, smoked or smokeless (for example cigarettes, shisha or chewing tobacco)?
entries.q.auditc.1: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol?
entries.q.auditc.2: How many standard drinks containing alcohol do you have on a typical day when you drink?
entries.q.auditc.3: How often do you have six or more drinks on one occasion?
entries.q.activity.moderate: In a typical week, how many minutes do you spend on moderate activity that makes you breathe a little faster, such as brisk walking, carrying loads or cycling?
entries.q.activity.vigorous: In a typical week, how many minutes do you spend on vigorous activity that makes you breathe much faster, such as running, football or heavy digging?
entries.q.diet.servings: On a typical day, how many servings of fruit and vegetables do you eat? One serving is about a handful.
entries.q.diet.salt: Do you add salt to your food at the table?
